intent.label: Intent
intent.instructions: What is the main intent of the author?

criteria.question: asks for information
criteria.complaint: complains about a problem or bad experience
criteria.request: asks for something to be done
criteria.feedback: gives an opinion, praise or suggestion

topic.label: Topic
topic.instructions: What is the text mainly about?

criteria.product: features, plans, how the product works

has_question.label: Contains a question
has_question.instructions: Does the text ask a question?

wants_refund.label: Asks for refund / compensation
wants_refund.instructions: Does the author ask for money back or compensation?

sentiment.label: Sentiment
sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of the text?

emotion.label: Emotion
emotion.instructions: Which emotion does the author mainly express?

sarcasm.label: Sarcasm
sarcasm.instructions: Is the author being sarcastic or ironic?

toxic.label: Toxic / insulting
toxic.instructions: Does the text contain insults, hate or abusive language?

threat.label: Threat / violence
threat.instructions: Does the text threaten violence or harm to someone?

spam.label: Spam / advertising
spam.instructions: Is the text spam or unsolicited advertising?

scam.label: Scam / phishing
scam.instructions: Does the text try to trick the reader into giving money, passwords or personal data?

personal_info.label: Contains personal info
personal_info.instructions: Does the text contain personal data such as a phone number, ID number, email or home address?

clarity.label: Clarity
clarity.instructions: How clear and easy to understand is the text?

detail.label: Detail level
detail.instructions: How much specific detail does the text give?

formality.label: Formality
formality.instructions: How formal is the writing style?

needs_reply.label: Needs a reply
needs_reply.instructions: Does the author expect a reply?

needs_human.label: Should go to a human
needs_human.instructions: Should a human staff member handle this personally?

churn.label: Churn risk
churn.instructions: Does the customer intend to cancel or switch to another provider?
